stemMd: A fixed rental cost was to be shared equally by 12 people. When 3 withdrew, each remaining person paid 8 units more. What was the total rental cost?
explanationMd: Let cost be C. Then C/9−C/12=8, so C/36=8 and C=288. Shares rise from 24 to 32, a difference of 8.

distractorRationale.e: This uses the wrong participant change.
distractorRationale.a: This multiplies the new group size by the increase only.
distractorRationale.c: This does not yield an 8-unit difference.
distractorRationale.b: This omits the difference between the two per-person fractions.
